title: Corner Office Conversation: Krish Ramineni on AI Teammates and the Future of Knowledge
description: AI is moving from experimental technology to an increasingly powerful part of everyday work. At The Economic Times World Leaders Forum, Krish Ramineni, Founder and CEO of Fireflies.ai, joins ET’s Himanshi Lohchab to discuss AI agents, the future of knowledge work, India’s AI opportunity, and why falling AI costs could dramatically expand its adoption.

title: World News | Elon Musk to Rename SpaceX AI Arm SpaceXSI After Trump Order Replacing AI with SI
description: Get latest articles and stories on World at LatestLY. SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk on Sunday (local time) confirmed that the company's artificial intelligence arm, SpaceXAI, will be renamed SpaceXSI, following US President Donald Trump's executive order calling for the term "Artificial Intelligence" (AI) to be replaced with "Super Intelligence" (SI) in the executive branch.

title: Jay Clayton to head US AI task force: Here’s what we know
description: Jay Clayton has taken on a pivotal role as Trump appoints him the AI czar to steer the newly established Super Intelligence Force. This strategic initiative aspires to fortify US dominance in artificial intelligence and related technologies. Clayton's mandate includes a 120-day assessment period to identify AI's risks and prospects.
